title: Charles VI to Count Leopold Viktorin Windischgrätz, four letters, Vienna 3 Feb 1720 - 11 Apr 1722, SOA Plzeň RA Windischgrätz (DECODE R5019-R5024)

documents.shelfmark: SOA Plzeň, RA Windischgrätz inv. 694 karton 5 (autograph, DECODE R5019); inv. 5 book 5 pp. 401-404 (copy, DECODE R5020)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the documents or in print; Mírka 2012 describes the letter but prints no decryption.

transcription.source: Numbers from the register copy R5020, checked against the autograph R5019 (DECODE images)
transcription.notes: 26 passages A-Z. --measure --digits gives 224 because the clear-text column of passage J contains the figure 50; the cipher columns hold 223 numbers (counted per line).

system.summary: Two keys: No. 1 in the Chancellery two-part nomenclator R5017 (1-400 letters, bigrams, trigrams and nulls; 401-977 words and names), Nos. 2, 3, 6 in the private key R5018 (letters as numbers 10-38 and graphic signs, vowels with a second number, ~300 codes 39-210 and two-letter groups, nulls 3-7, 9).
system.sibling_key: Not applicable: both keys (R5017, R5018) survive in the same family archive and were used directly.
system.notes: Homophone counts are for R5018 (number + sign per letter, vowels a second number); R5017 also gives single letters with homophones. R5017 nomenclator 401-977 is alphabetical (Aachen to zu). Key slips found in use: R5017 31 = zu (key: el), 268 = ein (key: em); R5018 copyist's signs drift (D/N, Z/G).

prior_solution.where: Mírka, Západočeské archivy 2012 (repr. Crypto-World 3-4/2013) describes the letters and keys but prints no decryption; none found by web search 19 Sept 2026

conditions.human_role: Supplied the DECODE login (session cookie) for images and key records.

solution.what: Fetched DECODE R5017-R5024 images and record pages; the letter records point to keys R5017 and R5018.
Mírka 2012 found: describes the private key and the Reichshofrat nomenclator, prints no decryption; web search found none.
Transcribed R5017 in full (syllabary 1-400, nomenclator 401-999; 41 low-confidence cells flagged).
Transcribed R5018 (24-letter grid of numbers and signs, ~300 codes, nulls).
No. 1 cipher numbers (26 passages) from the register copy, checked against the autograph (ct_1720-02-03.txt).
No. 1 decoded with R5017 via dec.py; key slips 31 = zu and 268 = ein found from sense; 446 and 638 stay uncertain.
Nos. 2, 3, 6 read with R5018 letter by letter; drifting copyist signs settled by the surrounding numbered letters.
All 35 passages read as German fitting the clear context and the 1720-22 diplomacy (Alberoni's fall, Beretti Landi marriage proposal).

outcome.fraction_read_source: dec_R5017_letter.md and dec_R5018_letters.md: cipher tokens (223 + 192 = 415); the uncertain nomenclator values 446 and 638 counted unread (2); signs marked ? but read in context counted read
outcome.notes: Both keys survive and were applied directly; no cryptanalysis. Nos. 4, 5 and 7 of the register are not on DECODE and have no document entry. The clear text of Nos. 2, 3, 6 is only summarised around the cipher passages.
